title.narrative: Mobilisation of Tajik youth in rural and urban areas to tackle climate change

description.narrative: Direct target group: (1) At least 280 adolescents and young adults (at least 50% of whom are female) aged 15-35 years(2) At least 36 villagers who are structurally or socially integrated in the target villages (3) 6 representatives from at least 3 local authorities at district level, including CEP (4) 5 representatives of CEP at national level.

Impact: Climate actors at government level and from civil society are working together at local level to contribute to the implementation of the National Climate Change Adaptation Strategy of the Republic of Tajikistan for the period up to 2030.Project objective: Through capacity development and networking, those responsible at government level, civil society and local young people are empowered to develop and implement strategies for adapting to climate change.

The project intends to activate and organize Tajik youth to engage on climate change with the long-term vision that they become agents of change to drive national climate change adaption and mitigation. The networking of civil society within Tajikistan and connection to global debates and knowledge hubs is a further key long term goal of the intervention.

participating-org.narrative: Germany - Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development
